process.title: 实现 windscale.py 蒲福风级及测试
process.scope: Owns only windscale.py and tests/test_windscale.py (new files only). Does not touch dijkstra, nthprime, or any existing file; does not import other project modules.
process.task: Implement windscale.py (standard library only, no imports of other project modules) and tests/test_windscale.py as new files; do not modify any existing file. Spec (verbatim from work order): 分级阈值钉死（单位 km/h，下限含、上限为下一级下限）：0 级 <1；1 级 1–5；2 级 6–11；3 级 12–19；4 级 20–28；5 级 29–38；6 级 39–49；7 级 50–61；8 级 62–74；9 级 75–88；10 级 89–102；11 级 103–117；12 级 ≥118。 `beaufort(speed_kmh) -> int`：speed 须为 int/float（bool 拒），非数值抛 TypeError；负数抛 ValueError；返回 0–12 的级数。 `beaufort_label(speed_kmh) -> str`：返回中文名，0–12 级依次为 无风、软风、轻风、微风、和风、清风、强风、疾风、大风、烈风、狂风、暴风、飓风；入参校验同 `beaufort`。 Acceptance examples (each must have a corresponding test case): `beaufort(0) == 0`；`beaufort(0.9) == 0`；`beaufort(1) == 1`；`beaufort(5) == 1`；`beaufort(6) == 2`；`beaufort(11) == 2`；`beaufort(12) == 3`；`beaufort(19) == 3`；`beaufort(20) == 4`；`beaufort(28) == 4`；`beaufort(29) == 5`；`beaufort(38) == 5`；`beaufort(39) == 6`；`beaufort(49) == 6`；`beaufort(50) == 7`；`beaufort(61) == 7`；`beaufort(62) == 8`；`beaufort(74) == 8`；`beaufort(75) == 9`；`beaufort(88) == 9`；`beaufort(89) == 10`；`beaufort(102) == 10`；`beaufort(103) == 11`；`beaufort(117) == 11`；`beaufort(118) == 12`；`beaufort(200) == 12`；`beaufort(32.5) == 5`；`beaufort_label(0) == "无风"`；`beaufort_label(3) == "软风"`；`beaufort_label(30) == "清风"`；`beaufort_label(55) == "疾风"`；`beaufort_label(100) == "狂风"`；`beaufort_label(118) == "飓风"`；`beaufort(-1)` 抛 ValueError；`beaufort("50")`、`beaufort(True)`、`beaufort(None)` 抛 TypeError。 Cover every acceptance item with a test case.
